versos.hebraico: וַיָּ֣שֶׁב אֹתִ֗י דֶּ֣רֶךְ שַׁ֤עַר הַמִּקְדָּשׁ֙ הַֽחִיצ֔וֹן הַפֹּנֶ֖ה קָדִ֑ים וְה֖וּא סָגֽוּר׃

controles.web: Then he brought me back by the way of the outer gate of the sanctuary, which looks toward the east; and it was shut.
controles.kjv: Then he brought me back the way of the gate of the outward sanctuary which looketh toward the east; and it was shut.
controles.livre: Então ele me fez voltar ao caminho da porta de fora do santuário, a qual estava voltada para o oriente; e ela estava fechada.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלַ֜י יְהוָ֗ה הַשַּׁ֣עַר הַזֶּה֩ סָג֨וּר יִהְיֶ֜ה לֹ֣א יִפָּתֵ֗חַ וְאִישׁ֙ לֹא־יָ֣בֹא ב֔וֹ כִּ֛י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בָּ֣א ב֑וֹ וְהָיָ֖ה סָגֽוּר׃

controles.web: Yahweh said to me, This gate shall be shut; it shall not be opened, neither shall any man enter in by it; for Yahweh, the God of Israel, has entered in by it; therefore it shall be shut.
controles.kjv: Then said the Lord unto me; This gate shall be shut, it shall not be opened, and no man shall enter in by it; because the Lord, the God of Israel, hath entered in by it, therefore it shall be shut.
controles.livre: E o SENHOR me disse: Esta porta estará fechada; não se abrirá, nem ninguém entrará por ela, porque o SENHOR Deus de Israel entrou por ela; por isso estará fechada.

versos.hebraico: אֶֽת־הַנָּשִׂ֗יא נָ֥שִׂיא ה֛וּא יֵֽשֶׁב־בּ֥וֹ לֶאֱכָול־לֶ֖חֶם לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה מִדֶּ֨רֶךְ אֻלָ֤ם הַשַּׁ֨עַר֙ יָב֔וֹא וּמִדַּרְכּ֖וֹ יֵצֵֽא׃

controles.web: As for the prince, he shall sit therein as prince to eat bread before Yahweh; he shall enter by the way of the porch of the gate, and shall go out by the way of the same.
controles.kjv: It is for the prince; the prince, he shall sit in it to eat bread before the Lord; he shall enter by the way of the porch of that gate, and shall go out by the way of the same.
controles.livre: O príncipe; somente o príncipe, ele se sentará nela, para comer pão diante do SENHOR; pelo caminho do alpendre da porta entrará, e pelo mesmo caminho sairá.

versos.hebraico: וַיְבִיאֵ֜נִי דֶּֽרֶךְ־שַׁ֣עַר הַצָּפוֹן֮ אֶל־פְּנֵ֣י הַבַּיִת֒ וָאֵ֕רֶא וְהִנֵּ֛ה מָלֵ֥א כְבוֹד־יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה וָאֶפֹּ֖ל אֶל־פָּנָֽי׃

controles.web: Then he brought me by the way of the north gate before the house; and I looked, and behold, Yahweh’s glory filled Yahweh’s house: and I fell on my face.
controles.kjv: Then brought he me the way of the north gate before the house: and I looked, and, behold, the glory of the Lord filled the house of the Lord: and I fell upon my face.
controles.livre: Depois me levou pelo caminho da porta do norte, diante da casa; e olhei, e eis que a glória do SENHOR havia enchido a casa do SENHOR; então caí sobre meu rosto.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלַ֜י יְהֹוָ֗ה בֶּן־אָדָ֡ם שִׂ֣ים לִבְּךָ֩ וּרְאֵ֨ה בְעֵינֶ֜יךָ וּבְאָזְנֶ֣יךָ שְּׁמָ֗ע אֵ֣ת כָּל־אֲשֶׁ֤ר אֲנִי֙ מְדַבֵּ֣ר אֹתָ֔ךְ לְכָל־חֻקּ֥וֹת בֵּית־יְהוָ֖ה וּלְכָל־תורתו וְשַׂמְתָּ֤ לִבְּךָ֙ לִמְב֣וֹא הַבַּ֔יִת בְּכֹ֖ל מוֹצָאֵ֥י הַמִּקְדָּֽשׁ׃

controles.web: Yahweh said to me, Son of man, mark well, and see with your eyes, and hear with your ears all that I tell you concerning all the ordinances of Yahweh’s house, and all its laws; and mark well the entrance of the house, with every exit of the sanctuary.
controles.kjv: And the Lord said unto me, Son of man, mark well, and behold with thine eyes, and hear with thine ears all that I say unto thee concerning all the ordinances of the house of the Lord, and all the laws thereof; and mark well the entering in of the house, with every going forth of the sanctuary.
controles.livre: E o SENHOR me disse: Filho do homem, presta atenção,  olha com teus olhos, e ouve com teus ouvidos tudo quanto eu falar contigo sobre todas os estatutos da casa do SENHOR, e todas as suas leis; e presta atenção na entrada da casa, e em todas as saídas do santuário.

versos.hebraico: וְאָמַרְתָּ֤ אֶל־מֶ֨רִי֙ אֶל־בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה רַב־לָכֶ֛ם מִֽכָּל־תּוֹעֲבֽוֹתֵיכֶ֖ם בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

controles.web: You shall tell the rebellious, even to the house of Israel, Thus says the Lord Yahweh: you house of Israel, let it suffice you of all your abominations,
controles.kjv: And thou shalt say to the rebellious, even to the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord God; O ye house of Israel, let it suffice you of all your abominations,
controles.livre: E dize aos rebeldes, à casa de Israel: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Já basta de todas as vossas abominações, ó casa de Israel!

versos.hebraico: בַּהֲבִיאֲכֶ֣ם בְּנֵֽי־נֵכָ֗ר עַרְלֵי־לֵב֙ וְעַרְלֵ֣י בָשָׂ֔ר לִהְי֥וֹת בְּמִקְדָּשִׁ֖י לְחַלְּל֣וֹ אֶת־בֵּיתִ֑י בְּהַקְרִֽיבְכֶ֤ם אֶת־לַחְמִי֙ חֵ֣לֶב וָדָ֔ם וַיָּפֵ֨רוּ֙ אֶת־בְּרִיתִ֔י אֶ֖ל כָּל־תּוֹעֲבוֹתֵיכֶֽם׃

controles.web: in that you have brought in foreigners, uncircumcised in heart and uncircumcised in flesh, to be in my sanctuary, to profane it, even my house, when you offer my bread, the fat and the blood, and they have broken my covenant, to add to all your abominations.
controles.kjv: In that ye have brought into my sanctuary strangers, uncircumcised in heart, and uncircumcised in flesh, to be in my sanctuary, to pollute it, even my house, when ye offer my bread, the fat and the blood, and they have broken my covenant because of all your abominations.
controles.livre: Pois trouxestes estrangeiros, incircuncisos de coração e incircuncisos de carne, para estarem em meu santuário, para profanarem minha casa; pois oferecestes meu pão, a gordura e o sangue; e invalidaram meu pacto, por causa de todas as vossas abominações.

versos.hebraico: וְלֹ֥א שְׁמַרְתֶּ֖ם מִשְׁמֶ֣רֶת קָדָשָׁ֑י וַתְּשִׂימ֗וּן לְשֹׁמְרֵ֧י מִשְׁמַרְתִּ֛י בְּמִקְדָּשִׁ֖י לָכֶֽם׃

controles.web: You have not performed the duty of my holy things; but you have set performers of my duty in my sanctuary for yourselves.
controles.kjv: And ye have not kept the charge of mine holy things: but ye have set keepers of my charge in my sanctuary for yourselves.
controles.livre: E não mantivestes a ordem de minhas coisas sagradas; em vez disso pusestes por vós mesmos guardas estrangeiros para minha ordem em meu santuário.

versos.hebraico: כֹּה־אָמַר֮ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִה֒ כָּל־בֶּן־נֵכָ֗ר עֶ֤רֶל לֵב֙ וְעֶ֣רֶל בָּשָׂ֔ר לֹ֥א יָב֖וֹא אֶל־מִקְדָּשִׁ֑י לְכָל־בֶּן־נֵכָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֕ר בְּת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

controles.web: Thus says the Lord Yahweh, No foreigner, uncircumcised in heart and uncircumcised in flesh, shall enter into my sanctuary, of any foreigners who are among the children of Israel.
controles.kjv: Thus saith the Lord God; No stranger, uncircumcised in heart, nor uncircumcised in flesh, shall enter into my sanctuary, of any stranger that is among the children of Israel.
controles.livre: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Nenhum estrangeiro, incircunciso de coração e incircunciso de carne, entrará em meu santuário, dentre todos os estrangeiros que estão entre os filhos de Israel.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֣י אִם־הַלְוִיִּ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֤ר רָֽחֲקוּ֙ מֵֽעָלַ֔י בִּתְע֤וֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תָּע֣וּ מֵֽעָלַ֔י אַחֲרֵ֖י גִּלּֽוּלֵיהֶ֑ם וְנָשְׂא֖וּ עֲוֺנָֽם׃

controles.web: But the Levites who went far from me, when Israel went astray, who went astray from me after their idols, they shall bear their iniquity.
controles.kjv: And the Levites that are gone away far from me, when Israel went astray, which went astray away from me after their idols; they shall even bear their iniquity.
controles.livre: Mas os Levitas que se afastaram para longe de mim, que se desviaram de mim para seguirem seus ídolos, quando Israel se desviou, esses levarão sobre si sua maldade.

versos.hebraico: וְהָי֤וּ בְמִקְדָּשִׁי֙ מְשָׁ֣רְתִ֔ים פְּקֻדּוֹת֙ אֶל־שַׁעֲרֵ֣י הַבַּ֔יִת וּֽמְשָׁרְתִ֖ים אֶת־הַבָּ֑יִת הֵ֠מָּה יִשְׁחֲט֨וּ אֶת־הָעֹלָ֤ה וְאֶת־הַזֶּ֨בַח֙ לָעָ֔ם וְהֵ֛מָּה יַעַמְד֥וּ לִפְנֵיהֶ֖ם לְשָֽׁרְתָֽם׃

controles.web: Yet they shall be ministers in my sanctuary, having oversight at the gates of the house, and ministering in the house: they shall kill the burnt offering and the sacrifice for the people, and they shall stand before them to minister to them.
controles.kjv: Yet they shall be ministers in my sanctuary, having charge at the gates of the house, and ministering to the house: they shall slay the burnt offering and the sacrifice for the people, and they shall stand before them to minister unto them.
controles.livre: Contudo serão trabalhadores em meu santuário, como porteiros às portas da casa, e servirão na casa: eles degolarão a oferta de queima e o sacrifício para o povo, e estarão diante deles para os servirem.

versos.hebraico: יַ֗עַן אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְשָׁרְת֤וּ אוֹתָם֙ לִפְנֵ֣י גִלּֽוּלֵיהֶ֔ם וְהָי֥וּ לְבֵֽית־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְמִכְשׁ֣וֹל עָוֺ֑ן עַל־כֵּן֩ נָשָׂ֨אתִי יָדִ֜י עֲלֵיהֶ֗ם נְאֻם֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה וְנָשְׂא֖וּ עֲוֺנָֽם׃

controles.web: Because they ministered to them before their idols, and became a stumbling block of iniquity to the house of Israel; therefore have I lifted up my hand against them, says the Lord Yahweh, and they shall bear their iniquity.
controles.kjv: Because they ministered unto them before their idols, and caused the house of Israel to fall into iniquity; therefore have I lifted up mine hand against them, saith the Lord God, and they shall bear their iniquity.
controles.livre: Pois os serviram diante de seus ídolos, e foram tropeço de maldade para a casa de Israel; por isso jurei de mão levantada contra eles, diz o Senhor DEUS, que levarão sua iniquidade.

versos.hebraico: וְלֹֽא־יִגְּשׁ֤וּ אֵלַי֙ לְכַהֵ֣ן לִ֔י וְלָגֶ֨שֶׁת֙ עַל־כָּל־קָ֣דָשַׁ֔י אֶל־קָדְשֵׁ֖י הַקְּדָשִׁ֑ים וְנָֽשְׂאוּ֙ כְּלִמָּתָ֔ם וְתוֹעֲבוֹתָ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשֽׂוּ׃

controles.web: They shall not come near to me, to execute the office of priest to me, nor to come near to any of my holy things, to the things that are most holy; but they shall bear their shame, and their abominations which they have committed.
controles.kjv: And they shall not come near unto me, to do the office of a priest unto me, nor to come near to any of my holy things, in the most holy place: but they shall bear their shame, and their abominations which they have committed.
controles.livre: E não se achegarão a mim para serem meus sacerdotes, nem se achegarão a nenhuma de minhas coisas sagradas; às coisas santíssimas; em vez disso levarão sobre si sua vergonha e suas abominações que fizeram.

versos.hebraico: וְנָתַתִּ֣י אוֹתָ֔ם שֹׁמְרֵ֖י מִשְׁמֶ֣רֶת הַבָּ֑יִת לְכֹל֙ עֲבֹ֣דָת֔וֹ וּלְכֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר יֵעָשֶׂ֖ה בּֽוֹ׃פ

controles.web: Yet will I make them performers of the duty of the house, for all its service, and for all that shall be done therein.
controles.kjv: But I will make them keepers of the charge of the house, for all the service thereof, and for all that shall be done therein.
controles.livre: Portanto os porei por guardas da ordem da casa, em todo o seu serviço, e em tudo o que houver de se fazer nela.

versos.hebraico: וְהַכֹּהֲנִ֨ים הַלְוִיִּ֜ם בְּנֵ֣י צָד֗וֹק אֲשֶׁ֨ר שָׁמְר֜וּ אֶת־מִשְׁמֶ֤רֶת מִקְדָּשִׁי֙ בִּתְע֤וֹת בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מֵֽעָלַ֔י הֵ֛מָּה יִקְרְב֥וּ אֵלַ֖י לְשָֽׁרְתֵ֑נִי וְעָמְד֣וּ לְפָנַ֗י לְהַקְרִ֥יב לִי֙ חֵ֣לֶב וָדָ֔ם נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃

controles.web: But the priests the Levites, the sons of Zadok, who performed the duty of my sanctuary when the children of Israel went astray from me, they shall come near to me to minister to me; and they shall stand before me to offer to me the fat and the blood, says the Lord Yahweh:
controles.kjv: But the priests the Levites, the sons of Zadok, that kept the charge of my sanctuary when the children of Israel went astray from me, they shall come near to me to minister unto me, and they shall stand before me to offer unto me the fat and the blood, saith the Lord God:
controles.livre: Mas os sacerdotes Levitas, filhos de Zadoque, que guardaram a guarda de meu santuário quando os filhos de Israel se desviaram de mim, eles se achegarão a mim para me servirem; e estarão diante de mim para me oferecerem a gordura e o sangue, diz o Senhor DEUS.

versos.hebraico: הֵ֜מָּה יָבֹ֣אוּ אֶל־מִקְדָּשִׁ֗י וְהֵ֛מָּה יִקְרְב֥וּ אֶל־שֻׁלְחָנִ֖י לְשָׁרְתֵ֑נִי וְשָׁמְר֖וּ אֶת־מִשְׁמַרְתִּֽי׃

controles.web: they shall enter into my sanctuary, and they shall come near to my table, to minister to me, and they shall keep my instruction.
controles.kjv: They shall enter into my sanctuary, and they shall come near to my table, to minister unto me, and they shall keep my charge.
controles.livre: Eles entrarão em meu santuário, e eles se achegarão à minha mesa para me servirem; e guardarão minha ordem.

versos.hebraico: וְהָיָ֗ה בְּבוֹאָם֙ אֶֽל־שַׁעֲרֵי֙ הֶחָצֵ֣ר הַפְּנִימִ֔ית בִּגְדֵ֥י פִשְׁתִּ֖ים יִלְבָּ֑שׁוּ וְלֹֽא־יַעֲלֶ֤ה עֲלֵיהֶם֙ צֶ֔מֶר בְּשָֽׁרְתָ֗ם בְּשַׁעֲרֵ֛י הֶחָצֵ֥ר הַפְּנִימִ֖ית וָבָֽיְתָה׃

controles.web: It shall be that, when they enter in at the gates of the inner court, they shall be clothed with linen garments; and no wool shall come on them, while they minister in the gates of the inner court, and within.
controles.kjv: And it shall come to pass, that when they enter in at the gates of the inner court, they shall be clothed with linen garments; and no wool shall come upon them, whiles they minister in the gates of the inner court, and within.
controles.livre: E será que, quando entrarem pelas portas do pátio interno, se vestirão de vestes de linho; não haverá sobre eles lã, quando servirem nas portas do pátio interno, e no interior.

versos.hebraico: פַּאֲרֵ֤י פִשְׁתִּים֙ יִהְי֣וּ עַל־רֹאשָׁ֔ם וּמִכְנְסֵ֣י פִשְׁתִּ֔ים יִהְי֖וּ עַל־מָתְנֵיהֶ֑ם לֹ֥א יַחְגְּר֖וּ בַּיָּֽזַע׃

controles.web: They shall have linen tires on their heads, and shall have linen breeches on their waists; they shall not clothe themselves with anything that makes them sweat.
controles.kjv: They shall have linen bonnets upon their heads, and shall have linen breeches upon their loins; they shall not gird themselves with any thing that causeth sweat.
controles.livre: Turbantes de linho estarão em suas cabeças, e calções de linho sobre seus lombos; não se vestirão com algo que lhes cause suor.

versos.hebraico: וּ֠בְצֵאתָם אֶל־הֶחָצֵ֨ר הַחִיצוֹנָ֜ה אֶל־הֶחָצֵ֣ר הַחִיצוֹנָה֮ אֶל־הָעָם֒ יִפְשְׁט֣וּ אֶת־בִּגְדֵיהֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁר־הֵ֨מָּה֙ מְשָׁרְתִ֣ם בָּ֔ם וְהִנִּ֥יחוּ אוֹתָ֖ם בְּלִֽשְׁכֹ֣ת הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ וְלָֽבְשׁוּ֙ בְּגָדִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים וְלֹֽא־יְקַדְּשׁ֥וּ אֶת־הָעָ֖ם בְּבִגְדֵיהֶֽם׃

controles.web: When they go out into the outer court, even into the outer court to the people, they shall put off their garments in which they minister, and lay them in the holy rooms; and they shall put on other garments, that they not sanctify the people with their garments.
controles.kjv: And when they go forth into the utter court, even into the utter court to the people, they shall put off their garments wherein they ministered, and lay them in the holy chambers, and they shall put on other garments; and they shall not sanctify the people with their garments.
controles.livre: E quando eles saírem ao pátio de fora, ao pátio de fora ao povo, despirão suas vestes com que eles prestaram serviço, as deixarão nas câmaras do santuário, e se vestirão de outras vestes, para que não santifiquem ao povo com suas vestes.

versos.hebraico: וְרֹאשָׁם֙ לֹ֣א יְגַלֵּ֔חוּ וּפֶ֖רַע לֹ֣א יְשַׁלֵּ֑חוּ כָּס֥וֹם יִכְסְמ֖וּ אֶת־רָאשֵׁיהֶֽם׃

controles.web: Neither shall they shave their heads, nor allow their locks to grow long; they shall only cut off the hair of their heads.
controles.kjv: Neither shall they shave their heads, nor suffer their locks to grow long; they shall only poll their heads.
controles.livre: E não raparão sua cabeça, nem deixarão crescer o cabelo; mas sim apararão o cabelo de suas cabeças.

versos.hebraico: וְיַ֥יִן לֹֽא־יִשְׁתּ֖וּ כָּל־כֹּהֵ֑ן בְּבוֹאָ֖ם אֶל־הֶחָצֵ֥ר הַפְּנִימִֽית׃

controles.web: Neither shall any of the priests drink wine, when they enter into the inner court.
controles.kjv: Neither shall any priest drink wine, when they enter into the inner court.
controles.livre: E nenhum dos sacerdotes beberá vinho quando forem entrar no pátio interno.

versos.hebraico: וְאַלְמָנָה֙ וּגְרוּשָׁ֔ה לֹֽא־יִקְח֥וּ לָהֶ֖ם לְנָשִׁ֑ים כִּ֣י אִם־בְּתוּלֹ֗ת מִזֶּ֨רַע֙ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְהָֽאַלְמָנָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּֽהְיֶ֣ה אַלְמָנָ֔ה מִכֹּהֵ֖ן יִקָּֽחוּ׃

controles.web: Neither shall they take for their wives a widow, nor her who is put away; but they shall take virgins of the seed of the house of Israel, or a widow who is the widow of a priest.
controles.kjv: Neither shall they take for their wives a widow, nor her that is put away: but they shall take maidens of the seed of the house of Israel, or a widow that had a priest before.
controles.livre: Não tomarão por mulheres nem viúva, nem divorciada, mas sim tomarão virgens da descendência  da casa de Israel, ou viúva que for viúva de sacerdote.

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־עַמִּ֣י יוֹר֔וּ בֵּ֥ין קֹ֖דֶשׁ לְחֹ֑ל וּבֵין־טָמֵ֥א לְטָה֖וֹר יוֹדִעֻֽם׃

controles.web: They shall teach my people the difference between the holy and the common, and cause them to discern between the unclean and the clean.
controles.kjv: And they shall teach my people the difference between the holy and profane, and cause them to discern between the unclean and the clean.
controles.livre: E ensinarão meu povo a fazer diferença entre o santo e o profano, e lhes farão saber a diferença entre o impuro e o puro.

versos.hebraico: וְעַל־רִ֗יב הֵ֚מָּה יַעַמְד֣וּ לשפט בְּמִשְׁפָּטַ֖י ושפטהו וְאֶת־תּוֹרֹתַ֤י וְאֶת־חֻקֹּתַי֙ בְּכָל־מוֹעֲדַ֣י יִשְׁמֹ֔רוּ וְאֶת־שַׁבְּתוֹתַ֖י יְקַדֵּֽשׁוּ׃

controles.web: In a controversy they shall stand to judge; according to my ordinances shall they judge it: and they shall keep my laws and my statutes in all my appointed feasts; and they shall make my Sabbaths holy.
controles.kjv: And in controversy they shall stand in judgment; and they shall judge it according to my judgments: and they shall keep my laws and my statutes in all mine assemblies; and they shall hallow my sabbaths.
controles.livre: E na disputa judicial eles estarão para julgar; conforme meus juízos o julgarão; e guardarão minhas leis e meus estatutos em todas as minhas solenidades, e santificarão meus sábados.

versos.hebraico: וְאֶל־מֵ֣ת אָדָ֔ם לֹ֥א יָב֖וֹא לְטָמְאָ֑ה כִּ֣י אִם־לְאָ֡ב וּ֠לְאֵם וּלְבֵ֨ן וּלְבַ֜ת לְאָ֗ח וּלְאָח֛וֹת אֲשֶֽׁר־לֹא־הָיְתָ֥ה לְאִ֖ישׁ יִטַּמָּֽאוּ׃

controles.web: They shall go in to no dead person to defile themselves; but for father, or for mother, or for son, or for daughter, for brother, or for sister who has had no husband, they may defile themselves.
controles.kjv: And they shall come at no dead person to defile themselves: but for father, or for mother, or for son, or for daughter, for brother, or for sister that hath had no husband, they may defile themselves.
controles.livre: E não chegarão perto de pessoa alguma morta para se contaminarem; apenas pelo pai, mãe, filho, filha, irmão, ou irmã que não tenha tido marido, é que poderão se contaminar.

versos.hebraico: וְאַחֲרֵ֖י טָֽהֳרָת֑וֹ שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים יִסְפְּרוּ־לֽוֹ׃

controles.web: After he is cleansed, they shall reckon to him seven days.
controles.kjv: And after he is cleansed, they shall reckon unto him seven days.
controles.livre: E depois de sua purificação lhe contarão sete dias.

versos.hebraico: וּבְיוֹם֩ בֹּא֨וֹ אֶל־הַקֹּ֜דֶשׁ אֶל־הֶחָצֵ֤ר הַפְּנִימִית֙ לְשָׁרֵ֣ת בַּקֹּ֔דֶשׁ יַקְרִ֖יב חַטָּאת֑וֹ נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃

controles.web: In the day that he goes into the sanctuary, into the inner court, to minister in the sanctuary, he shall offer his sin offering, says the Lord Yahweh.
controles.kjv: And in the day that he goeth into the sanctuary, unto the inner court, to minister in the sanctuary, he shall offer his sin offering, saith the Lord God.
controles.livre: E no dia que ele entrar no lugar santo, no pátio interno, para prestar serviço no lugar santo, oferecerá sua expiação pelo pecado, diz o Senhor DEUS.

versos.hebraico: וְהָיְתָ֤ה לָהֶם֙ לְֽנַחֲלָ֔ה אֲנִ֖י נַֽחֲלָתָ֑ם וַאֲחֻזָּ֗ה לֹֽא־תִתְּנ֤וּ לָהֶם֙ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲנִ֖י אֲחֻזָּתָֽם׃

controles.web: They shall have an inheritance: I am their inheritance; and you shall give them no possession in Israel; I am their possession.
controles.kjv: And it shall be unto them for an inheritance: I am their inheritance: and ye shall give them no possession in Israel: I am their possession.
controles.livre: E isto lhes será por herança: eu serei sua herança; por isso não lhes dareis propriedade de terra em Israel; eu sou a propriedade deles.

versos.hebraico: הַמִּנְחָה֙ וְהַחַטָּ֣את וְהָאָשָׁ֔ם הֵ֖מָּה יֹֽאכְל֑וּם וְכָל־חֵ֥רֶם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לָהֶ֥ם יִהְיֶֽה׃

controles.web: They shall eat the meal offering, and the sin offering, and the trespass offering; and every devoted thing in Israel shall be theirs.
controles.kjv: They shall eat the meat offering, and the sin offering, and the trespass offering; and every dedicated thing in Israel shall be theirs.
controles.livre: Comerão a oferta de alimentos e o sacrifícios pelo pecado e pela culpa; e toda coisa dedicada em Israel pertencerá a eles.

versos.hebraico: וְרֵאשִׁית֩ כָּל־בִּכּ֨וּרֵי כֹ֜ל וְכָל־תְּר֣וּמַת כֹּ֗ל מִכֹּל֙ תְּרוּמ֣וֹתֵיכֶ֔ם לַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים יִֽהְיֶ֑ה וְרֵאשִׁ֤ית עֲרִסֽוֹתֵיכֶם֙ תִּתְּנ֣וּ לַכֹּהֵ֔ן לְהָנִ֥יחַ בְּרָכָ֖ה אֶל־בֵּיתֶֽךָ׃

controles.web: The first of all the first fruits of every thing, and every offering of everything, of all your offerings, shall be for the priest: you shall also give to the priests the first of your dough, to cause a blessing to rest on your house.
controles.kjv: And the first of all the firstfruits of all things, and every oblation of all, of every sort of your oblations, shall be the priest’s: ye shall also give unto the priest the first of your dough, that he may cause the blessing to rest in thine house.
controles.livre: E as primícias de todos os primeiros frutos de tudo, e toda oferta de tudo o que se oferecer de todas as vossas ofertas, pertencerá aos sacerdotes; dareis também as primícias de todas vossas massas ao sacerdote, para que faça repousar a bênção em tua casa.

versos.hebraico: כָּל־נְבֵלָה֙ וּטְרֵפָ֔ה מִן־הָע֖וֹף וּמִן־הַבְּהֵמָ֑ה לֹ֥א יֹאכְל֖וּ הַכֹּהֲנִֽים׃פ

controles.web: The priests shall not eat of anything that dies of itself, or is torn, whether it be bird or animal.
controles.kjv: The priests shall not eat of any thing that is dead of itself, or torn, whether it be fowl or beast.
controles.livre: Os sacerdotes não poderão comer coisa alguma morta por si mesma ou despedaçada, tanto de aves como de animais.
